data.professional_title: Lead Data Scientist/ Generative AI Expert
data.summary:
7+ Years in Data Science & Generative AI
Experienced Data Scientist and AI Engineer proficient in the entire end-to-end machine learning process, from data preparation to production, including deploying and monitoring models for real-time and batch inference. Proficient in analytical and statistical techniques, including machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and large language models. Skilled in utilizing cloud services like AWS, GCP, and Azure. Known for creative problem-solving, such as developing a generative AI gift-suggestion tool and automating incident reporting with NLP. Passionate about pushing data's limits to drive innovation in every data-related challenge.
Generative AI: Pushes the boundaries of innovation in projects spanning Generative AI, MLOps, and AWS cloud services using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Machine Learning: Proficient in machine learning techniques, meticulously orchestrates data pipelines and enriches projects with advanced insights.
MLOps: Orchestrated data pipelines and leveraged MLOps practices to optimize performance, ensuring seamless model deployment and monitoring.
Cloud: Extensive experience in 3rd-party cloud resources: AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure. Proficient in a multitude of AWS cloud services, including EC2 for scalable compute, ECR for container management, ECS for orchestration, Lambda for
serverless computing, Sagemaker for machine learning, API Gateway for secure API management, and Glue for ETL workflows.
NLP: Applied Natural Language Processing techniques, including tokenization,
stemming, lemmatization, Word2Vec, Transformers, sentiment analysis, Name Entity Recognition, and Topic Modelling to extract actionable intelligence from text data.
Deep Learning: Developed and trained state-of-the-art Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs), RNNs, LSTMs, Transformers and deep-learning models using Keras,
TensorFlow and PyTorch.
CI/CD Orchestrator: Established and maintained robust CI/CD workflows using
Jenkins and GitHub Actions, enabling agile software development and deployment.
Collaborative Leader: Led cross-functional teams with agility, conducted agile ceremonies, and meticulously documented project progress for transparent and efficient project delivery.

PG Diploma in Management – Rennes School of Business, France | Jan 2017 - Dec 2017
Bachelor’s Degree – Osmania University | Jan 2003 - Aug 2007
Professional Experience
Boven Technologies | June 2018 – Dec 2024	AI/ML Engineer
PwC (US-ADV GHG Non-Prod) |
AI/ML Engineer – Agenda Walkthrough Project
Domain: ESG / Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Data & Corporate Agenda Automation
Client: PwC Internal (ESG/PMO Assistant Teams)
Individual Role: AI/ML Engineer & Solution Architect
Technology: Python, FastAPI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Azure Functions, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Dataverse, SharePoint, FAISS, Hugging Face,
Gradio, Streamlit, Docker, Azure AI Services, Prompt Engineering, Generative AI, RAG, Multi-Agent Systems.
Project Description:
This project developed an Agenda Walkthrough Assistant that automates ESG/GHG data collection, company background research, and questionnaire answering for PwC’s PMO
teams. The system integrates multiple knowledge bases (SharePoint, websites, conversation logs) into a unified retrieval-augmented pipeline using LangChain and Azure Dataverse. It
leverages Microsoft Copilot Studio for adaptive dialogs and Power Automate for document workflows (Word generation, SharePoint upload). The solution includes multi-agent
orchestration (retrieval, summarization, orchestrator agent) for generating companyspecific walkthroughs, ensuring consistency and efficiency in client meetings and reporting.
Responsibilities:
Designed and implemented the Agenda Walkthrough pipeline integrating SharePoint knowledge bases, websites, and questionnaire templates.
Built retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows with LangChain/LlamaIndex for contextual answers.
Developed multi-agent orchestration (retrieval agent, knowledge agent, orchestrator agent) for automated walkthrough generation.
Created Power Automate flows to generate and store Word documents with Q&A outputs directly into SharePoint.
Implemented backend APIs with FastAPI and built interactive frontends (Gradio, Streamlit) for tester/end-user validation.
Deployed solutions on Azure Functions and Dataverse for enterprise-grade scalability.
Led knowledge ingestion pipeline design (chunking, embeddings with FAISS, vector indexing strategies).
Mentored developers on prompt engineering, Copilot Studio nodes, and Azure integrations.
Key role in UAT preparation by creating Excel-based UAT trackers, testing scripts, and providing support to testers.
Collaborated with PwC PMO and ESG teams to ensure domain alignment with sustainability reporting standards.
African Union Development Agency – AUDA-NEPAD
Consultant (AI/ML Engineer – NLP & Multilingual Systems) | Akili AI – 100M MSME Initiative
Domain: MSME Empowerment / Artificial Intelligence / NLP
Client: AUDA-NEPAD (African Union)
Team Size: 8
Individual Role: AI/ML Engineer (Consultant)
Technology: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, AWS Bedrock, AWS Lambda, S3, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Llama, OpenSearch, Multilingual NLP,
Prompt Engineering, Generative AI, MLOps.
Project Description:
The Akili AI platform is being built under the African Union’s 100M MSME Initiative to provide AI-powered business guidance to small and medium enterprises across Africa. The project enhances the existing MVP by integrating advanced language capabilities, multilingual NLP (English, French, African languages), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines. It delivers context-aware answers, real-time financing eligibility checks via external APIs, and localized guidance on regulatory compliance and operations.
Responsibilities:
Reviewed and assessed the existing MVP architecture including data ingestion, embeddings, and vector search pipeline.
Designed and fine-tuned open-source LLMs (Llama, Hugging Face models) on AWS Bedrock for multilingual tasks.
Developed advanced prompt engineering strategies to improve accuracy and minimize hallucinations.
Implemented multilingual support (English, French + African languages) with translation pipelines and native multilingual LLMs.
Integrated real-time financing eligibility feature by connecting APIs with intelligent prompt design for localized advice.
Optimized RAG performance through embedding strategies, latency reduction, and cost-efficient deployment.
Set up monitoring dashboards for tracking performance (latency, token usage, model drift).
Authored clear documentation (model architecture, pipelines, prompt strategies) and conducted knowledge transfer sessions for internal AU teams.
Delivered prototypes for Multilingual NLP and Financing Eligibility features along with final handover reports..
4. Human Activity Recognition using CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) on Tensorflow & Keras
Domain: Artificial Intelligence
Technology: Python, Tensorflow, Keras, Scikit-learn, Importing Libraries, CNN, Neural Networks, Computer Vision, Google Colab, Statistics.
Project Description: This project used the WISDM dataset, which contained data collected through controlled, laboratory conditions, with a total of 1098207 examples. The dataset included six different labels (Downstairs, Jogging, Sitting,
Standing, Upstairs, Walking) and accelerometer data was used to train the model to predict human activity.
Responsibilities:
Loading & Preprocessing the dataset.
Balancing & Standardization of data.
Creating frames by using SciPy library.
Using 2D Convolutional Neural Networks to build the model.
Using Tensorflow-Keras to build the CNN Model.
Using mlxtend to plot the Confusion Matrix.
